actions.create_company.description: Creates a new company (customer) in Beebole.
actions.create_company.props.corporate.d: Enable if this company represents your own organization (internal/corporate) rather than a customer.
actions.create_company.props.name.descri: The name of the company (customer) to create.
actions.create_multiple_time_entries.des: Creates time entries (working time or absence) across multiple days in Beebole.
actions.create_multiple_time_entries.pro: The absence type (e.g. Vacation, Sick Leave) to log on the selected dates.
Optional comment applied to every created time entry.
The company that owns the project.
If enabled, a failure on one date will not stop creation for the remaining dates.
The dates to create time entries for, each in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-05-21").
Choose whether you are logging working time on a subproject or an absence (e.g. vacation, sick leave).
The number of hours to log for each date (e.g. 8 for a full working day).
The subproject to log working time against.
actions.create_person.description: Creates a new person in Beebole. An available license is required for the person to be active.
actions.create_person.props.company.desc: The company this person belongs to.
actions.create_person.props.email.descri: Email address. Required if you want to invite the person to log in to Beebole.
actions.create_person.props.invite.descr: Send an invitation email so the person can log in to Beebole. Requires an email address.
actions.create_person.props.name.descrip: The full name of the person (e.g. "Jane Doe").
actions.create_person.props.userGroup.de: The permission level for this person. "Employee" can log time; "Project Lead" can also manage projects; "Admin" has full access.
actions.create_project.description: Creates a new project under a company in Beebole.
actions.create_project.props.company.des: The company (customer) that owns this project.
actions.create_project.props.name.descri: The name of the new project (e.g. "Website Redesign").
actions.create_project.props.startDate.d: The project start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-01-15"). Leave empty for no start date.
actions.create_subproject.description: Creates a new subproject under an existing project in Beebole.
The company that owns the parent project.
actions.create_subproject.props.name.des: The name of the new subproject (e.g. "Prototype", "Phase 1").
The project that will contain this subproject.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.deactivate_subproject.descriptio: Marks a subproject as inactive in Beebole. Inactive subprojects are hidden from new time entries.
actions.deactivate_subproject.props.comp: The company that owns the project.
actions.deactivate_subproject.props.proj: The project containing the subproject to deactivate.
actions.delete_multiple_time_entries.des: Deletes multiple time entries (working time or absence) by their IDs and dates.
actions.delete_multiple_time_entries.pro: If enabled, a failure on one entry will not stop deletion for the remaining entries.
List of time entries to delete. Each row requires the time entry ID and the date it was logged on (YYYY-MM-DD).
auth.description:
To get your Beebole API token:

1. Log in to your Beebole account at https://beebole-apps.com
2. Go to **Customize → API Token**
3. Generate a new API token 
4. Copy the token and paste it below

Need help? See https://beebole.com/help/api
description: Time tracking and project management. Create companies, projects, people, and log time entries.
